summary: SQLite’s built-in lower converts uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase.
documentation: SQLite’s built-in lower converts uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase. Other characters are unchanged in the default build. NULL input remains NULL.
returns: Text with ASCII uppercase converted, or NULL.
caution: This is not full Unicode case folding. Do not use it as a universal policy for matching people’s names.
scenarios: Normalize documented ASCII status labels in an export.
Create lowercase internal category codes for a report.
Compare ASCII-only command labels after case normalization.
title: Lowercase status text
problem: From jobs(id INTEGER, status TEXT), return id and lower(status) as normalized, ordered by id. Use the default ASCII behavior and preserve NULL.
goal: Use lower() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
